Hero.hero2: Don't look for a job. Let it find you.
Hero.hero3: Join tournaments, help other developers, be visible and let companies come looking for you.

step1.title: Join
step1.description: Hop into Discord and introduce yourself to the community.

step2.title: Showcase and collaborate
step2.description: Share your projects, collaborate in open tournaments, and get your questions answered by the community.

step3.title: Get discovered
step3.description: Get feedback, stay active, and let companies and recruiters discover you.

step4.title: Land your opportunity
step4.description: Turn that interest into interviews and land your next job.

talent.title: Offer yourself as talent
talent.subtitle: Tell us what you're best at and let them find you
talent.talent1: A real person looks at your profile
talent.subtalent1: No blind software rejects your application before someone with good judgment sees what you can do
talent.subtalent2: We won't ask you for five years of experience for an entry-level position. Tell us what you can do today.
talent.subtalent3: Creating your profile, taking part in the challenges, and talking to companies won't cost you a single cent.
